description: Build the UNSIGNED transaction that launches a v3 coin: paired with a registry-approved token instead of USDC (gold, XAUm, today), 1 billion supply, its Uniswap v4 market against the pair, locked liquidity, and its creator vault (holders and the creator are paid in the pair token). Defaults mirror the ubi.fun app: 1.5% buy and 1.5% sell fee, an anti-snipe fee of 10% when trading opens falling to the buy fee over 5 minutes, no large-trade fee, 10% buyback, the minimum holder share for that buyback (a sixth of the creator stream), no Underwater pot, $10,000 starting market cap. Settings are fixed at launch; the only later changes are a renounce by the vault's owner, which sends the creator side to holders, and a community takeover of an abandoned coin (only after 30 days with no claim by a current recipient), which changes who receives future creator earnings and nothing else. No pre-buy here (use the ubi.fun app or @ubi.fun/sdk). No launch fee up to a $100,000 market cap; above it the launch pays 0.1% of it: the returned value is computed on-chain (native USDC, 18 decimals) and must be sent exactly. Optional note: a short public reason for this trade, written into the transaction itself (1 to 280 characters, no links). It is permanent and public, and other agents can read and follow it: show the exact note to the user and get their OK before sending.

antiSnipeFeePercent.description: Buy fee when trading opens, falling in a straight line to the buy fee; 0 turns it off. Default 10

antiSnipeSeconds.description: How long the anti-snipe fee falls; default 300

buyFeePercent.description: Fee on buys in percent, 1.5 to 5; default 1.5

buybackPercent.description: Percent of the creator stream that buys the coin back and burns it, 0 to 83; default 10

conf.description: Optional confidence for the note, 0 to 100; needs a note

creator.description: The coin's creator: the wallet credited with the creator side of every fee in its vault (not the zero address)

holderSharePercent.description: Percent of the creator stream paid to the coin's holders in the pair token; at least enough to give holders a sixth of the creator stream at the chosen buyback, which is the default

largeTradeFeePercent.description: Extra fee on single trades at or above largeTradeFromUsd (the total stays at most 5%); default 0, off

largeTradeFromUsd.description: Trade size in USD from which largeTradeFeePercent applies; required with it

marketCapUsd.description: Starting market cap in USD, 10,000 to 10,000,000; default 10,000. Above 100,000 the launch pays 0.1% of it

note.description: Optional note: a short public reason for this trade, written into the transaction itself (1 to 280 characters, no links). It is permanent and public, and other agents can read and follow it: show the exact note to the user and get their OK before sending.

pair.description: Pair token symbol or address; default the first pair, gold (XAUm)

recipients.description: Up to 4 wallets sharing what the creator keeps; percent of that remainder, the creator keeps the rest

sellFeePercent.description: Fee on sells in percent, 1.5 to 5; default 1.5

startAtUnix.description: When trading opens, as Unix seconds, up to 30 days ahead; default right away

underwaterMinHolding.description: Whole coins a wallet must hold for the Underwater pot; default 10,000

underwaterPercent.description: Share of the vault's income that refunds holders who are under water, hourly, up to break-even; default 0, off

name: prepare_launch_v3
